comments.author: C***a
comments.content: The buttons and joysticks are all working except for the touchpad, but you can press the touchpad. It has a different material from an original PS4 controller. As you can see on Picture 3, the red LED light can be seen through the USB port. Compared to the original PS4 controller, it should be covered, you can’t see the LED through the USB port. It may not be like the original but nonetheless, it works as an alternative and it’s affordable. Bluetooth connection works with my phone, however, it doesn’t have the same blinking/flashing of the LED light of an original PS4 controller. It successfully paired with my PS4 console and when I checked in the Devices section, it was recognized as DualShock 4. I haven’t experienced any issues yet during my gameplay with the controller. Lastly, the shipping and delivery was fast, it only took 3 days.

comments.author: Adrian Deans
comments.content: I am docking one star because I asked the seller if this controller was authentic and they assured me it was. These are not genuine PS4 controllers. With that being said this controller is legit! I was certain that these were not authentic from the price and packaging. Also back sticker has some errors, and screws different. Now to the meat and potatoes! This controller build quality is very similar to the original controller. Only feels slightly lighter. All buttons feel the same, have the same resistance and there is no flex when holding the controller. I was worried most about the toggles as I play FPS games. This controller doesn’t disappoint! My ordinal controller toggles need to be replaced so decided to try my luck with this one. Smooth action and aiming! I am hoping these controllers last! Don’t hesitate to buy. I bought 2 and they both work flawlessly. Hopefully this helps the next buyer. Happy with purchase. Thanks!
